note: No public registry record could be located for this exact name. Searches for the full name and for the distinctive fragment 'MICROWAVE AND CHIP DEVICES ASSEMBLY' returned only unrelated results (Zepto quick-commerce, microwave appliance retailers); no MCA/LLP master-data page, no GSTIN profile, no PAN, no LLPIN, no incorporation date, no registered-office state and no audited financials were retrievable. Registry aggregator pages (ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck, Tofler, InstaFinancials) returned HTTP 403 and the search backend was intermittently unavailable, so absence of a record is NOT established — this is 'not found in public sources', not proof of non-existence. Per project rules the entity is therefore NOT rejected (rejection requires confirmed non-existence/strike-off/liquidation/bankruptcy, which could not be confirmed either way). All fields left null rather than guessed; no CIN/LLPIN, PAN or GSTIN was invented. Note also that the claimed industry 'Строительство и DIY' (construction/DIY) is inconsistent with the company name (microwave and chip device assembly = electronics manufacturing/assembly) and with declared HS 702000 (glassware) — HS is not a rejection ground per rules, but the actual product code should be corrected once the entity is identified. Recommended next step: manual MCA master-data lookup by name on mca.gov.in and GST portal search, plus confirmation of the exact legal-name spelling from the supplier's own documents (GST certificate / LLP agreement), since the name may be misspelled or the entity may be very recently registered.
